title: ascyrum hypericoides var. oblongifolium
intro: Ascyrum hypericoides var. oblongifolium, commonly known as Mexican valerian, is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Mexican valerian include acting as a nervine sedative, anti-anxiety agent, and muscle relaxant. Its bioactive constituents include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
